title: drugMR run parameters
description: Validated by drugmr.config.Config. One file per (pheno_id, pqtl_dataset) under params/ - e.g. params/AD.wingo_brain.yaml. `gates` is optional.

sumstats.description: Path to the outcome GWAS summary statistics.

pqtl_dataset.description: Must match a dataset registered in assets/qtl_manifest.csv.

ref_bfile.description: Path to the 1000G reference panel bfile prefix.

run_smr.description: Master on/off switch for the SMR step.

bulk_qtl_datasets.description: Pre-computed bulk QTL datasets (eQTL, sQTL, mQTL) under results/SMR/bulk/; [] = skip bulk SMR.

sc_qtl_dataset.description: Single-cell QTL dataset name under dat/sc-QTL/; empty = skip sc SMR.

overwrite.description: Overwrite all current output files for this run.

gates.description: Per-step statistical thresholds. Optional - a missing gates block (e.g. the legacy assets/config.yaml) falls back to the same defaults bin/coloc_targets.py used to hardcode.

wald_fdr_q.description: FDR-q cutoff for single-instrument (Wald ratio) proteins.

cochran_q_pval.description: Minimum Cochran's Q p-value (i.e. no significant heterogeneity) for IVW proteins.

egger_intercept_pval_min.description: Minimum (exclusive) Egger intercept p-value for IVW proteins.

min_instruments_for_ivw.description: Instrument count at/above which IVW (rather than Wald ratio) is the gating method.

apply_steiger_filter.description: Hard-drop instruments failing Steiger directionality (R2_GX > R2_GY). Off by default - near-vacuous for cis-pQTLs given the variance-explained asymmetry; steiger_dir/steiger_pval are always retained as reported columns regardless of this flag.

clump_kb.description: LD clumping window (kb) for instrument selection.

clump_r2.description: LD clumping r2 threshold for instrument selection.

instrument_pval_threshold.description: p-value cutoff for selecting independent instrument SNPs.

pp4_threshold.description: Minimum PP.H4.abf (shared causal variant) to pass pairwise coloc.

p1.description: coloc.abf prior: SNP causal for trait 1 only.

p2.description: coloc.abf prior: SNP causal for trait 2 only.

p12.description: coloc.abf prior: SNP causal for both traits (shared).

p_qtl_smr.description: QTL p-value threshold the SMR tool uses to select the top cis-QTL per probe.

p_qtl_heidi.description: QTL p-value threshold the SMR tool uses to select SNPs included in the HEIDI test.

p_smr_threshold.description: Maximum q_SMR (FDR-corrected) to pass the SMR result gate.

p_heidi_threshold.description: Minimum p_HEIDI to pass the SMR result gate (i.e. no evidence of linkage/pleiotropy).

prior_1.description: HyPrColoc sensitivity plot: prior probability a SNP is causal for a given trait.

prior_c.description: HyPrColoc sensitivity plot: prior probability of colocalisation given causality.

reg_thresh.description: HyPrColoc sensitivity plot: regional association probability thresholds.

align_thresh.description: HyPrColoc sensitivity plot: alignment probability thresholds.

equal_thresholds.description: HyPrColoc sensitivity plot: force reg_thresh and align_thresh to be equal.

pp4_threshold.description: Minimum H4 to pass PWCoCo (kept independent from gates.coloc.pp4_threshold - PWCoCo and coloc are allowed to disagree by design).

bonferroni_alpha.description: Family-wise error rate for the per-protein Bonferroni correction across endpoints tested.

coloc_threshold.description: Minimum PWCoCo H4 for a target to be unioned into the PheWAS target set. 0 = every PWCoCo result is included, unfiltered by PP4.
